message.content: {"version":"1","chosen":[{"id":"o6","why":"Olive base with warm neutrals answers cool walk and tonal goal."},{"id":"o4","why":"Khaki set anchors the day; camel cardigan adds warmth without formal coat."},{"id":"o5","why":"Grey sweater and boots match cobblestones; add a third piece for occasion."}],"outfits":[{"id":"o6","caption":"Warm neutral base, olive trousers","pole":"tonal_column","items":["#184·42","#284·36","#133·20","#501·15"],"day":"The corduroy mini dress carries the tonal scheme's warm beige tone while the viscose khaki trousers add an olive cool contrast for the walk on cobblestones; the relaxed sweater and leather bag complete the column."},{"id":"o4","caption":"Khaki set, camel cardigan","pole":"ease_the_knot","items":["#284·36","#113·37","#553·42","#197·33"],"day":"The olive trousers and beige wide-leg blazer define the relaxed silhouette needed for cobblestones; the cashmere scarf adds soft texture without the bulk of a coat, keeping the look ready for movement."},{"id":"o5","caption":"Grey sweater, camel boots, cardigan","pole":"anchor_first","items":["#200·10","#171·37","#480·12"],"day":"The grey fitted sweater anchors the cool palette while the camel ankle boots continue the leg line on stones; adding a beige layer like a vest or lightweight jacket fills the warmth gap for the autumn air."}],"needed":[{"kind":"bottom","description":"A second bottom in khaki or olive to vary the set or add a skirt option.","type":"trousers","color":"khaki","fabric":"cotton"},{"kind":"outerwear","description":"A structured layer like a trench or blazer to add definition and warmth.","type":"trench_coat","color":"beige","fabric":"woven"}]}
